note: golive-unseen-gate2 (docs/222 §11, Rodney 2026-11-06 R1 + R3): default-ON gate for unseen-direct go-live. Old cadence / pushes / GoHome bars do not gate. Runs at pace 78. Read V6 (gate2-report.ts) after the 4 *-gu2-t-ab* jobs: V6 FAIL does not stop the queue, so stop it by hand, the later jobs would be at a pace about to change, and run golive-unseen-gate2-pace.json. Build first: ts3native.asi.mono1106c from master; ts3fixes.package.mono1106c (kAutLive True by default since O6) at the chosen pace; ts3fixes.package.mono1106c-rel as the release builds it; ts3agent with focus_watch. Read: node tools/harness/gate2-report.ts golive-unseen-gate2-<date>. Trimmed 2026-11-06 (Rodney, §11.9): 31 to 27 jobs, the 4 *-gu2-fastspeed-ab and *-gu2-speed1-ab jobs are gone (read only by naming them, no bar, R1-R4 log rows); the *-gu2-x-* jobs carry the X4 bench (--ab fwnull --fixedwork 8), so run x4-smoke.json first. Audit=50 cost: no arm, gate2-report.ts reads ts3native cutAuditUs per arm (bar 0.5 ms/s, my judgement).
